raw_text: Chainalysis Research: Attribution of WazirX Hack to DPRK Lazarus Group. Chainalysis has confirmed with high confidence that the $230 million theft from Indian cryptocurrency exchange WazirX was conducted by North Korea's Lazarus Group. Our on-chain analysis identified wallet addresses previously used in Lazarus operations, characteristic mixing patterns through Tornado Cash, and social engineering indicators targeting exchange employees. Simultaneously, DPRK-affiliated accounts promoted counter-narratives attributing the theft to insider fraud.
